searchText: I've read somewhere that for The Merge to "go genesis" there's a certain amount of ETHs needs to be overall staked or a minimum number of validators... But I can't find it anymore 😦 If someone knows what I'm talking about and can refer me to the relevant link I'll appreciate that. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#genesis-settings the `MIN_GENESIS_ACTIVE_VALIDATOR_COUNT` value.
